description: ignorePaths is the list `config:recommended` brings in through `:ignoreModulesAndTests`, minus `**/examples/**`: the Kubernetes example manifests under examples/ carry the SteVe tag and must be extracted, which the preset silently prevented (measured by hack/renovate-extract-check.sh). `**/test/**` stays, so the fixtures under hack/test/ are not read as pins

packageRules.description: Stay on the MariaDB LTS track for the throwaway build database, matching what most SteVe deployments actually run
Upstream prefixes its release tags. Declared once here rather than per manager: the Dockerfile pin and the documentation examples are extracted separately but describe the same tag format

customManagers.description: SteVe release tag — pinned in exactly one place, the Dockerfile ARG that both the release build and the pull-request build read

Docker images referenced from a workflow env block rather than from a FROM line — every workflow, so that a linter or scanner added later is managed on arrival rather than frozen at the version it was introduced with

SteVe release tag in the Markdown documentation and in the Kubernetes example manifests — same depName as the Dockerfile pin, so the examples move in the same PR instead of freezing silently. Prose has no adjacent `# renovate:` comment to read, hence the templates; every .md file and every YAML under examples/, so a document or manifest added later is managed on arrival
